title: Embedding fidelity smoke harness and drift telemetry
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable evaluation harness for embedding accuracy and reranker regressions: curated golden sets, nightly offline metrics, and drift detection with automated alerts. The goal is to detect quality regressions and distribution drift early (before marketing or customers notice) and to measure the accuracy/latency tradeoffs introduced by quantization, batching, and model swaps used by the embeddings + reranking endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: A golden set (v1) of >=5k labeled examples exists in the canonical S3 path and is documented in the dataset registry
Nightly offline run produces a report with MAP@10, precision@10, nDCG@10, cosine AUC, and mean rank for each candidate embedding model and reranker variant
Drift detectors (PSI + KS + bootstrap CI) run automatically and open an alert in #embeddings-alerts when thresholds are exceeded
Latency and cost diagnostics included in nightly report (p50/p95 embedding latency, rerankp95, per-request token breakdown)
Regression gating: >5% drop in MAP@10 or drop in cosine AUC with p<0.01 opens a paging-style alert and creates ENG ticket
Playbook describing steps for triage, regression rollback, and canary rollout exists in Confluence and is linked from the dashboard
implementation_notes: Harness will be a PyTest-like suite + Airflow DAG. Design: nightly batch job samples production queries via reservoir sampling (sample size configurable, default 25k/day) stratified by tenant and query length bucket. Each sample is evaluated against the golden set and live negative sampling strategy (hard negatives from recent logs). Metrics computed with bootstrap CI; population drift computed using PSI thresholds (0.2 for moderate drift, 0.4 for severe) and two-sample KS on embedding distributions. Reranker evaluation uses pairwise labels from goldens and runs both cross-encoder (for quality baseline) and lightweight scorer (for latency baseline). Reports persisted as JSONL in s3 and surfaced to console dashboard. Alerts wired to Datadog + Slack. Use a canary path for new model versions and compare against pinned baseline model.

comments: 2026-03-06 — Aisha: Initial scoping complete. Decided to target 5k gold examples balanced across three verticals (docs/search/snippets). Next: run exploratory sampling against last 30 days of production queries.
2026-03-07 — Marco: Design review feedback incorporated. Added tenant-stratified sampling and fixed sample seed for reproducibility. Will store goldens in S3 and register in dataset registry.
2026-03-09 — Observability (Jamie): Prototype PSI/KL detector implemented. We should use PSI=0.2 as warning, 0.4 as critical. Will add bootstrap CI for MAP to reduce false positives.

2026-03-11 — Marco: Baseline run completed comparing embedding-v1 (quant-8) vs embedding-v2 (q4_0). Observed MAP@10 drop of 3.2% for embedding-v2 and reranker recall unchanged. Within gating (5%) but drift signal for short queries triggered (PSI=0.22). Marking for follow-up investigation.
2026-03-12 — Aisha: Created the emb-qa-nightly Airflow DAG and a dashboard skeleton. Next: wire alerting to #embeddings-alerts and create automated ticket generator for P0 gating failures.

2026-03-13 — Marco: Added latency instrumentation to reranking endpoint; p95 for cross-encoder rerank on 50 candidates is ~420ms on the current dedicated pool. We should evaluate two-tier rerank (sparse candidate selection + cross-encoder for top-10) to meet SLOs.
2026-03-13 — SRE (Luis): Recommend adding a fallback policy: if nightly run detects severe drift, pause model rollout and route to pinned baseline. We'll add that to playbook.
